query:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN street IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sql_null_street,
  SUM(CASE WHEN street = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as empty_string_street,
  SUM(CASE WHEN street = 'NULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as string_null_street,
  SUM(CASE WHEN street IS NOT NULL AND street != '' AND street != 'NULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_real_street,
  COUNT(*) as total
FROM pco_people 
WHERE status = 'active' AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND latitude != 0
LIMIT 5;
